page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-focused virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a baseline frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, offering 94,489 GB of local HDD storage. This high-density magnetic storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, enabling efficient data transfer rates for large-scale sequential read and write operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the integration of high-capacity HDD storage rather than solid-state drives makes this instance highly resource-dense for bulk storage workloads. It is designed for workloads that require massive storage volumes without the premium cost of SSDs. Appropriate workloads include large-scale data warehousing, distributed file systems, cold data archiving, log processing, and big data analytics pipelines.
